title: Essential Oils from the Leaves, Stem, and Roots of Blumea lanceolaria (Roxb.) Druce in Vietnam: Determination of Chemical Composition, and In Vitro, In Vivo, and In Silico Studies on Anti-Inflammatory Activity.
authors: Do, Thi Thanh Huyen; Nguyen, Thi Uyen; Nguyen, Thi Thu Huyen; Ho, Thi Yen; Pham, Thi Luong Hang; Le, Tho Son; Nguyen, Thi Hong Van; Nguyen, Phi-Hung; Nguyen, Quang Huy; Nguyen, Van Sang
one_liner_zh: 该文研究植物精油化学成分及其抗炎活性，分子对接仅针对炎症通路蛋白，与蛋白质-DNA互作及TF-DNA结合机制完全无关。
abstract: Blumea lanceolaria (Roxb.) Druce, a flowering plant, is used for treating cancer and inflammatory diseases. In this study, we determined the chemical composition of the EOs extracted from the leaves (LBEO), stem (SBEO), and roots (RBEO) of B. lanceolaria and analyzed their anti-inflammation potential. Overall, 30 compounds representing 99.12%, 98.44%, and 96.89% of total EO constituents of the leaves, stem, and roots, respectively, were identified using GC-MS. ELISA, Western blotting, and qRT-PCR studies showed that LBEO, SBEO, and RBEO inhibited multiple steps in the inflammatory responses in the RAW 264.7 cell model, including NO production; TNF-alpha, IL-6, iNOS, and COX-2 transcription and translation; and phosphorylation of IkappaBalpha and p65 of the NF-kappaB pathway. In the carrageenan-induced paw edema model, all three EOs inhibited paw edema at both early and delayed phases. Molecular docking studies indicated that the main components of B. lanceolaria EOs (BEOs) targeted and inhibited major components of inflammation-related pathways, including the arachidonic acid metabolic pathway, NF-kappaB pathway, and MAPK pathway. We present the first study to characterize the chemical composition of BEOs and confirm their potent anti-inflammatory effects in in vitro, in vivo, and in silico analysis. These results can facilitate the development of effective anti-inflammatory drugs with limited side effects in the future.
abstract_zh: Blumea lanceolaria (Roxb.) Druce，一种开花植物，用于治疗癌症和炎症性疾病。在本研究中，我们测定了从B. lanceolaria的叶（LBEO）、茎（SBEO）和根（RBEO）中提取的精油（EOs）的化学成分，并分析了其抗炎潜力。总体而言，通过GC-MS鉴定出30种化合物，分别占叶、茎和根总精油成分的99.12%、98.44%和96.89%。ELISA、Western blotting和qRT-PCR研究表明，LBEO、SBEO和RBEO在RAW 264.7细胞模型中抑制了炎症反应的多步骤过程，包括NO产生；TNF-alpha、IL-6、iNOS和COX-2的转录和翻译；以及NF-kappaB通路中IkappaBalpha和p65的磷酸化。在角叉菜胶诱导的爪水肿模型中，所有三种精油在早期和延迟阶段均抑制了爪水肿。分子对接研究表明，B. lanceolaria精油（BEOs）的主要成分靶向并抑制了炎症相关通路的主要组分，包括花生四烯酸代谢通路、NF-kappaB通路和MAPK通路。我们首次报道了BEOs的化学成分特征，并通过体外、体内和计算机模拟分析证实了其强效抗炎作用。这些结果有助于未来开发具有有限副作用的有效抗炎药物。
